newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Btp-Bund spread narrows to new record.
newsitem.headline: Italy Btp-Bund spread narrows to new record.

text.p: The benchmark February 2007 Btp yield spread over the July 4, 2007 Bund narrowed to a new record of 127 basis points in late European trade.
It then moved back out to stand 127 basis points by 1340 GMT.
At the same time, the September BTP future on LIFFE hit a new record high at 132.76, exceeding Tuesday's high of 132.67.
The September Btp future was trading 18 basis points higher on the day at 132.76.
